clarification_rules: No recognisable capability or objective in the requirement: CLARIFY, no investigation run.
Requested version not stated: INVESTIGATE_WITH_UNKNOWNS; version applicability stays unknown.
Operator confirmation missing: REFUSE before any evidence is read.
Plan and API version are not stated: ask before any plan or API claim.
unsupported_behavior: Feature claim from Magento Open Source release notes: UNSUPPORTED_SOURCE (MAGENTO-01).
Any page outside the approved boundary, or a redirect leaving it: REFUSED, no evidence used.
Any inactive or unapproved source: UNSUPPORTED_SOURCE, no request made.

feasibility_rules.status: PROPOSED, NOT APPROVED. The current specialist contract declares feasibility not determined.
feasibility_rules.rule: A class follows only from each capability's investigation outcome. No class is assigned from confidence.

qa_acceptance_checklist: Registry ID matches AGENT_REGISTRY.yaml and specialists/catalog.py.
Every capability's source_id exists in docs/specialists/knowledge/sources.json.
No capability is marked verified without a retrieved and checked page.
Edition and version constraints are stated wherever a claim depends on them.
Unsupported and refused outcomes are labelled unknowns, never findings.

coverage.verified_scope: verified by approved pilot evidence only for single-product retrieval through the documented v3 product endpoint
coverage.partial: broader product catalog reading is partially verified; only single-product retrieval is established

verified_capability_statements.statement: Single-product retrieval through the documented v3 product endpoint.
